arms.question: Reference arm: no capture, no recall.
Does writing memory help without reading it?
Does current memory help at all?
Does feedback add anything on top of current recall?
Does re-check add anything on top of current recall?
Does retrieval help when capture quality is held fixed?

limits: This small JavaScript pilot is diagnostic. Each held-out series has one recurrence task, so an arm sees few recurrence observations even with enough held-out attempts. Results apply to the model and runtime that produced them. Auto-routed models, dry runs and scripted runs never qualify for promotion.
